summary: Section 68 (Referral commissions B1-B7, Web Push C1-C4, Banners refactor A1, EarningsPanel F1-F3, Push nudge F4). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (100%). Frontend: F1/F2/F3 PASS via Playwright; F4 push nudge correctly hidden in Playwright because Notification.permission=='denied' (expected — flow path validated indirectly).
passed_backend: B1 — POST /api/referrals/jobs (self-referral 400, non-provider 400, valid create returns enriched referrer/referred, status=pending, commission_pct=5.0)
B2 — Notification with title containing 'refirió' inserted for referred user
B3 — POST /accept (referrer forbidden, referred returns 200, status=accepted, accepted_at set)
B4 — POST /complete with final_amount=400 → status=completed, commission_amount=20.0 (5%)
B6 — Cancel before completion (200, status=cancelled); cancel after completion (400)
B7 — /me/sent and /me/received return lists, sorted desc by created_at, enriched with business_name etc
C1 — /api/push/public-key 200, no auth, length 88 (base64url P-256 uncompressed)
C2 — /api/push/subscribe requires auth (401 anon), authed returns ok:true, idempotent on endpoint
C4 — /api/push/unsubscribe returns ok:true matched:1, removes from /me
passed_frontend: F1 — mi-red-tab-earnings tab present; EarningsPanel renders hero ($32.50 total = seed $12.50 + pytest-created $20) and 4-stat breakdown
F2 — earnings-new-referral-btn opens new-referral-modal with 2 allies listed (from network + followers)
F3 — sent list shows María→Roberto $250 / $12.50 commission with status 'Completed', plus newer pytest entries
REGRESSION — MiRedPage shows 4 tabs: following, followers, suggestions, earnings (matches spec)
notes: F4 (push nudge) — In Playwright Chromium running headless via preview ingress, Notification.permission='denied' (not 'default'), so the 'Enable instant notifications' nudge is intentionally hidden. The conditional rendering logic in SmartActionHub is correct per the requirement. This MUST be verified manually in a real browser where permission is 'default'. Helper ensurePushSubscription() and POST /api/push/subscribe are validated directly via pytest with fake subscription credentials.

F1 hero shows $32.50 because the pytest run created a 2nd completed referral (Roberto, final $400 → $20 commission). Original $12.50 from seed Roberto-$250 still present and visible in F3 list. Per-row $12.50 / $20 commissions display correctly. Aggregate math is right.
/api/notifications/me titles include 'refirió' string confirming B2 notification creation.
action_items: Optional: cleanup TEST_* referral entries created by pytest (TEST_Cliente Pytest, TEST_Cancelable, etc.) so the demo data matches the spec exactly (Maria earned exactly $12.50). Currently aggregate is $32.50 due to test artifacts.

Optional: add 'has_referral_target' boolean response shortcut so F4 push nudge can be validated in Playwright by stubbing Notification.permission='default' via context option `permissions=['notifications']`.
critical_code_review_comments: EarningsPanel.jsx correctly handles empty states and renders 4 stat tiles with data-testid; good DRY usage of <StatTile/>.
routes/referral_jobs.py — commission_amount calculation rounds with float arithmetic; recommend Decimal for financial precision in P3.
routes/push.py — public-key endpoint returns raw VAPID public key from env (good); subscribe upsert by endpoint ensures idempotency.
server.py wires referrals/push/banners routers near line 9780; banners block successfully extracted (no duplicate definitions remain).
